reference_commit: cesm3.0-alphabranch cmeps checkout + fork branch instrument/cmeps-dumps (EqESM-cesm-cmeps 735eb8b, cmeps submodule bd88a843)
description: CMEPS atmosphere-ocean bulk-flux boundary traces from an instrumented C_JRA_t62 (DATM+MOM6) CESM run (PLAN.md CMEPS lane): the full flux_atmOcn_large chain of cesm/flux_atmocn/flux_atmocn_Large.F90 (Large & Pond / Large & Yeager scheme as configured in nuopc.runconfig: add_gusts=.false., coldair_outbreak_mod=.false., aofluxes_use_shr_wv_sat=.true., minwind=0.5 m/s, flux_convergence=0.01, flux_max_iteration=5), one row per traced ocean point per coupling step. Columns: the 12 raw inputs (zbot, ubot, vbot, thbot, qbot, rainc, rbot, tbot, pslv, us, vs, ts), the derived inputs (vmag, wind0, ugust, esat, qsat, ssq, delt, delq, alz, cp), the neutral first estimates (stable0, rdn0, rhn0, ren0), the exit state of the stability iteration (iter, hol, stable, xsq, xqq, psimh, psixh, rd, u10n, rdn, rhn, ren, rh, re, ustar, tstar, qstar), the fluxes (tau, taux, tauy, sen, lat, lwup, evap) and the 2-m/10-m diagnostics (hol2, xsq2, xqq2, psix2, fac_t, fac_q, tref, qref, duu10n, u10res), plus the point metadata (n local ogrid index on PET 0, gid global element index, lat/lon).

regenerate.note: Fork worktree stage1/EqESM-cesm-cmeps (branch instrument/cmeps-dumps, cmeps submodule on instrument/cmeps-dumps), CIME scripts from the pristine checkout stage1/cesm/cime. The dump is gated by the mediator attribute dump_cmeps (default .false., set in user_nl_cpl), writes PET 0 only, and traces the first dump_first_cells masked ocean cells for the first dump_first_steps coupling steps; CSV lands in stage1/dumps/cmeps/ (set by dump_dir in user_nl_cpl). user_nl_mom carries AUTO_MASKTABLE=False to match the reference case (root cause of a MOM6 init FATAL; buildnml regenerates MOM_override during case.build). Floats are written es26.17e3 with subnormals flushed to 0.0 (gfortran es26.17 omits the exponent letter, bugs.md #21); rainc is dumped as 0 on the no-gusts path (the mediator's 1-element dummy allocation is uninitialized, bugs.md #20). Run takes ~8 min wall; ~140 s rebuild per dump-module change.

run.result: COMPLETED exit 0:0, case.run success, model execution success
run.dates: start 0001-01-01, STOP_OPTION=nmonths STOP_N=1 (one month; 24 hourly coupling steps traced)
run.pes: TOTALPES=72 on 1 node (NTASKS=24/16/24/16/24/24 for ATM/LND/ICE/OCN/ROF/CPL-ish NUOPC shared layout; flux_atmOcn_large on the mediator PETs)
run.precision: real64 everywhere (CESM default; flux_atmocn_Large is r8)

(analytic Goff & Gratch, wv_sat_use_tables=.false.), flux_convergence=0.01, flux_max_iteration=5, minwind=0.5 m/s (seq_flux_atmocn_minwind). dump_files.cmeps_aoflux.csv: # description + # columns header, then one row per (step, traced cell): step,ymd,tod,n,gid,iter,lat,lon,zbot,ubot,vbot,thbot,qbot,rainc,rbot,tbot,pslv,us,vs,ts,vmag,wind0,ugust,esat,qsat,ssq,delt,delq,alz,cp,stable0,rdn0,rhn0,ren0,hol,stable,xsq,xqq,psimh,psixh,rd,u10n,rdn,rhn,ren,rh,re,ustar,tstar,qstar,tau,taux,tauy,sen,lat,lwup,evap,hol2,xsq2,xqq2,psix2,fac_t,fac_q,tref,qref,duu10n,u10res - inputs and outputs of flux_atmOcn_large (see the # description header for per-column units and F90 line citations); hol/xsq/xqq are the zbot-level pre-2m-rescale values (hol0/xsq0/xqq0 of the instrumentation), hol2/xsq2/xqq2 the 2-m-rescaled diagnostics

traced_domain.cells: first 12 masked ocean cells of PET 0 (dump_first_cells=12): local ogrid indices n 6933..7117, global element ids gid 41583..42667, all ~69 S on the Antarctic coast (PET 0's slice of the tx0.66v1 ocean grid)
traced_domain.steps: all 24 hourly coupling steps of the 1-month run (dump_first_steps=24)

checks.bit_identical_outputs: instrumented run restarts md5-identical to the reference C_JRA_t62 run (cpl.r 0f47e2f0f4f207240148d8ef333d5044, datm.r e14609a64cbba942d56a9eaa961c4bda, dice.r 8e1656e609b0c189b68284b940b2a19b, drof.r 002ca0b2a42c135246a5134e2517e00e, mom6.r 2f19de039ced94bcd30930385cc29b76) and ocean.stats.nc byte-identical, so the dump code changes nothing when enabled
checks.full_replay: stage1/analysis/validate_cmeps_dump.py replays flux_atmOcn_large from the dumped inputs and reproduces all 46 compared columns (every dumped column except the 12 inputs and the metadata) on all 288 rows to <= 4.4e-15 relative, and the dumped iter on all rows (iteration counts in the window: 2 x145, 3 x85, 4 x37, 5 x21 rows)
checks.structure: 2 header lines (# description, # columns), 288 data rows, 67 columns, zero wrong-arity rows, zero NaN, zero spval-like values (rainc = 0 on all rows after the bugs.md #20 fix)
checks.coverage: all 288 rows unstable (hol in [-10.0, -1.16], 21 rows pinned at the |hol| <= 10 clamp) with low-to-moderate wind (vmag 0.5..4.8 m/s, 17 rows pinned at the minwind = 0.5 m/s floor) and small nonzero ocean currents (us/vs in +/-0.13 m/s); the stable branch, the cdn 33 m/s wind cap, the add_gusts gustiness path and the cold-air-outbreak path are NOT exercised by this window
checks.iteration_representation: the esm model unrolls the 5 fixed-point updates and selects the exit state by conv_k = |(ustar_k - ustar_{k-1})/ustar_k| <= 0.01 (k = 1..4), iter = first converged k else 5; the stage-2 tests pin conv_1..4 and iter alongside the dumped columns
